## Version And Environment

Tirion version/commit, operating system, relevant language/framework, and interface
(CLI, API, MCP, or UI).

## Expected And Observed Behavior

Which graph relationship or result was expected? What happened instead?

## Reproduction

Include the command/tool input and a minimal synthetic or redistributable source
example. For cross-repo behavior, show both sides of the relationship. Include
workspace/snapshot context without exposing private identifiers unnecessarily.

## Relevant Output

Redact credentials, personal data, and private source. Do not attach full database
dumps. Sensitive security reports belong in the private channel described in
SECURITY.md, not this public issue.
